items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: What was his name? Hooker? Played the cornet, I think.

ctx.x: Some daughter over there. Yeah, I think they were living around Genesis. Ron Jenner Street somewhere around there. Ron Jenner Ferret somewhere. I know that's why he died at Ron. I'm telling you, I know that's why he died, because I used to pass didn't talk with him. But that's all I know, Ron. All the other old people there passed away. But I knew them.

I remember Harrison Barnes told us about a few musicians. Yeah. Let's see, Hooker was one. Was he on this side of the river? The trumpet player was on the... What was his name? Hooker? Played the cornet, I think. Sounds like they might be Tom.
The only one I knew over there played trumpet was like Peter, the old timers. Not nothing of trumpet.
